name: hole
description: Hole and Fruit Hole - single-file Three.js hole games, packaged for mobile via Capacitor

scripts.add:fruithole: cross-env APP=fruithole npx cap add android
scripts.sync:hole: node build-www.mjs && npx cap sync android
scripts.sync:fruithole: node build-www.mjs && cross-env APP=fruithole npx cap sync android
scripts.open:fruithole: cross-env APP=fruithole npx cap open android
